verificationRecords.notes: Unannotated contributor accumulator and lost RHS output variant caused type failures; initial test annotation was circular too. Three tests pass, covering varied multiples and row directions, exact inverse recovery, residual identity, actual solution families, provenance, immutable source entries, RHS participation and located invalid-input repairs.

Full app, node, test, Svelte and domain checks pass. Node and test checks rerun after final cost-attribution changes and pass.
